# Security Policy

## Supported Versions
Security fixes are provided for:
- `main` branch (active development)
- Latest production release branch (if present)

## Reporting a Vulnerability
Do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities.

Use one of the following:
1. GitHub private vulnerability reporting for this repository.
2. Email the security team: security@electrahub.com

Include:
- Description and impact
- Reproduction steps / PoC
- Affected versions and components
- Suggested remediation (if available)

## Response Targets
- Initial acknowledgement: within 1 business day
- Triage and severity assignment: within 3 business days
- Critical remediation target: within 24-72 hours
- High remediation target: within 7 calendar days
- Medium remediation target: within 30 calendar days
- Low remediation target: within 90 calendar days
